value.rationale: The result gives a complete local exchange landscape for a current record covering code, not an arbitrary slice. The source's own descent method deletes low-private-coverage codewords and repairs the resulting deficit, so the exact one-word repair sets directly characterize the first local move available at its flagship \(K_6(8,4)\) endpoint. Showing that 165 of 166 deletions admit no alternative one-word repair, while exactly one deletion admits exactly one, explains why further improvement cannot come from a simple one-for-one exchange and identifies the unique nontrivial local move. The all-deletions radius-\(5\) statement and exact private-region census are natural boundary invariants of the cover.
